title: Clear ubuntu_perf_fixes.sh from the shell coverage allowlist
objective: Bring ubuntu_perf_fixes.sh to 100% measured line coverage and remove its allowlist exemption, leaving nvidia_config.sh as the only untested lib in fixes/lib.
acceptance_criteria: The jail reports ubuntu_perf_fixes.sh at 100.00% through tests/run_all.sh at --min 100, exiting 0.
check_shell_coverage.sh passes on it with the allowlist line already deleted.
bt_audio.sh still measures 127/127 with the new test files present, since adding a file to this suite has silently broken a cleared lib before.

All four functions are covered: the sysctl drop-in and its undo fallbacks, both NVIDIA branches (helper service and standalone fallback), earlyoom install/configure/backup, and fix_failed_sssd for none, all and exactly one failed unit.
The add_undo lines keep their literal /etc paths, because the undo script runs on the real system.
No write reaches /etc: neither /etc/sysctl.d/99-performance-tuning.conf nor /etc/default/earlyoom exists after the suite runs.
The lib stays under the 250-line cap and shellcheck reports nothing, with zero suppressions.
out_of_scope: nvidia_config.sh, the last untested lib, which needs its own harness.
The ~12 gated libs outside fixes/lib that already fail the gate for reasons predating this work.
arch_sysctl.sh, which stays quarantined and exempt.
verifier: timeout 900s bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh --timeout 600s --subject linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh --measure ubuntu_perf_fixes.sh --min 100 --fail-on-case-error -- "" (expects 81/81 = 100.00%, exit 0), then the same for bt_audio.sh as a canary, then check_shell_coverage.sh with the allowlist line removed.
